allFundGroups.name: Taxes
allFundGroups.note: City property, fuel, utility-service and communications taxes and franchise fees.

allFundGroups.name: Licenses & permits
allFundGroups.note: Includes the merchant fee, business receipts and permits.

allFundGroups.name: Government revenue
allFundGroups.note: Shared taxes, grants and contributions from other governments.

allFundGroups.name: Charges for services
allFundGroups.note: Water, sewer, garbage, fire assessments and other charges, including internal-service activity.

allFundGroups.name: Miscellaneous, net
allFundGroups.note: Other receipts net of budget reserve adjustments.

allFundGroups.name: Other funding sources
allFundGroups.note: Includes transfers, borrowing and other financing sources. Not all new revenue.

generalFundGroups.name: Property taxes
generalFundGroups.note: Taxes on taxable property value, including delinquent collections.

generalFundGroups.name: Merchant fee
generalFundGroups.note: The city’s merchant gross-sales charge. Businesses and visitors also contribute.

generalFundGroups.name: Other taxes & franchise fees
generalFundGroups.note: Fuel, utility-service and communications taxes, plus utility franchise fees.

generalFundGroups.name: State and other government revenue
generalFundGroups.note: Shared taxes, grants and other government funding; some uses are restricted.

generalFundGroups.name: Fire assessment
generalFundGroups.note: A dedicated charge for fire services; separate from property-tax millage.

generalFundGroups.name: Other service charges
generalFundGroups.note: Service and administration charges. Some are payments from other city operations.

generalFundGroups.name: Other licenses & permits
generalFundGroups.note: Business receipts, permits and right-of-use fees.

generalFundGroups.name: Other income
generalFundGroups.note: Interest, rents and other receipts; not necessarily recurring.

generalFundGroups.name: Transfers from other funds
generalFundGroups.note: Internal funding, not new money for the city as a whole.

generalFundGroups.name: Reserve adjustment
generalFundGroups.note: A negative budget adjustment, not a tax or revenue collected from residents.
